d.text: Here’s how your week in Paris will unfold, day by day, along with everything you need to know about your hotel, meals, and important deadlines

d.t1:
Kaptiva Sports check-in, approx. 2:30–3:30 PM in the lobby of the reference hotel — welcome pack and players' kit handed out
Welcome meeting, approx. 4:00–5:00 PM
Airport transfers are not included in this pack
d.t2:
Players travel by bus from the reference hotel to the training facilities with our staff
Four days of double training sessions. Players are transported from the reference hotel to their morning session, spend the day with their team, and return to the hotel after the second training session for parent pick-up.
Training sessions are closed to relatives, except Parent's Day. The exact date will be confirmed closer to the event
d.t3:
A free day for Essential Pack families
Organized activities finish on the evening of November 27, so we recommend departing on November 28
Airport transfers are not included in this pack

d.title: Your reference hotel
d.text:
The hotel is not included, but it will be the daily meeting point: players meet our staff there before travelling to all activities and training sessions, and return there at the end of each day
The reference hotel will be located in the La Défense district. Families arrange their own accommodation

d.title: Meals included
d.text:
**Players only:** lunch on the 4 double-training-session days
**Relatives:** no meals included

The exact reference hotel name will be confirmed approximately one month before the event.
PSG first-team match tickets are not included in the pack.
Unregistered relatives cannot attend training sessions or extra activities, or use the group buses.
The detailed schedule is coming soon.

d.title: Any questions about your pack?
d.text: Review or update your registration {[E-MODIFY REG LINK]} — or reply to this email and our team will help you.
